STFT is an alternative spectral source, not the mechanism of the transform itself - a substitutable input is not a dependency.

Not identity (formant is the resonance; the model is the decomposition), not purpose (SERVES, which speech-processing already holds), not DERIVED_FROM (formant is not a historical source of the model). Same accepted shape as the standing formant-vocoder / formant-tracking DEPENDS_ON formant edges.

Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. Prosody is carved as a systematic framework for analyzing pitch/loudness/duration patterns — a subfield that studies a domain of the sound system, not a concrete member of the phonology category. Prosody does not stand to phonology as a particular sound-system stands to the discipline; it stands as a subfield (a CONTAINS / member relation, not INSTANCE_OF). The note's own 'subdomain of phonology' framing is a discipline-membership appeal, which is exactly the sense Law 9a says does not file INSTANCE_OF.

Law 9: specific to its nearest accepted kind. A formant is a concrete, particular acoustic resonance — a peak in the speech spectrum corresponding to a vocal-tract cavity resonance — while resonance is the general phenomenon (amplified response at a natural frequency). A formant stands to resonance exactly as one particular resonance stands to the kind, unlike the discipline cases above. Resonance is the nearest kind: formant already holds DEPENDS_ON and DERIVED_FROM to resonance (accepted), and this INSTANCE_OF is the missing kind-ladder rung, not a leap over an accepted rung.

Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. Speech processing is a signal-processing discipline that transforms/analyzes/synthesizes speech signals (it DEPENDS_ON signal-processing, accepted). Computational linguistics is a separate disciplinary framework for formalizing linguistic knowledge in algorithms. Speech processing applies computational methods to speech; that is a cross-discipline application, not speech-processing being a concrete instance of computational-linguistics. 'A subfield of computational linguistics' is a subfield-membership appeal, which Law 9a says files no INSTANCE_OF.

Law 8b removal test fails. Spectral analysis decomposes a signal into frequency components via a mathematical transform (Fourier). Removing the signal-processing discipline does not stop the transform operating — the mechanism is mathematics (the Fourier transform, windowing as math), not the discipline as such. A thing does not depend on its own discipline for operation (Law 2b / 8b: 'X as a concept needs the discipline' is true of every entry and files nothing). Kind-membership is already captured by the accepted spectral-analysis INSTANCE_OF signal-processing; DEPENDS_ON would duplicate that as a false operational dependency.

Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. An utterance is a bounded unit of action — a contiguous stretch of speech participants treat as one unit; discourse is the conventionally structured form of communication that sequences such units. The utterance is the constituent, not an instance of the discourse kind. The note's own 'discourse unit' phrasing is a part-of / member framing (discourse encompasses multi-utterance sequences), which is CONTAINS, not INSTANCE_OF. The real arrow is the reverse dependency; INSTANCE_OF mis-cuts.
